kitDescription: Soda is a Fire-element machine-gun Supporter whose kit is almost entirely sustain. Her Skill 1 builds Maid Spirit stacks on herself — one stack of +13% Max HP per 180 normal attacks fired, up to 5 stacks, each lasting 10 seconds. Her Skill 2 periodically heals the whole team for a small fraction of her own Max HP, and once Maid Spirit is fully stacked each activation additionally heals a much larger fraction. Her Burst I deals a single moderate hit to randomly selected enemies with a brief stun, and grants every Fire-element ally +1 stack count on their stackable buffs — which for Soda herself means an extra Maid Spirit stack. In a damage sim her offensive footprint is just her MG fire and the burst hit; her heals matter only insofar as they trigger teammates' on-recovery effects, and her Max HP stacking converts to nothing without an HP-to-ATK consumer.

skill1.driverSaid: hitCount 180 → self targetMaxHpPct 13, maxStacks 5, durationSec 10, plus +1 to a maidSpirit resource pool mirroring the stack count (the gate-able state S2 reads)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 converged exactly (hitCount 180/self/13%/5/10s, stat spelled maxHpPct — both damage-inert); S5 pins cadence, cap, timed-window semantics, self-scope, and inertness, all GREEN vs the driver override
skill1.formulaCheck: Max HP is damage-inert for soda (no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer in her kit or the fixture); the driver's SD2 pair proves both the inertness AND that the e3 self-feed channel is live (a hypothetical converter WOULD read it) — correct handling per SSOT §1a e3 scope
skill1.explanation: Trigger identity (hitCount 180; hitsPerShot 1 so hits == pulls), target set, magnitude, stack cap, and wall-clock duration all match the prose. Driver pins the exact application count (floor(shots/180) + burst casts) and discriminates against a halved-threshold misread. The monotonic-pool vs 10s-expiry divergence is real but documented, and unreachable under sustained MG fire (180 rounds accrue well inside 10s).

skill2.explanation: Fires at t=12..168 (14 ticks, pinned frame-exact), reaches all four allies through the consumer, discriminates against a 6s misread (29 ticks). The unencodable magnitude is honestly documented rather than fudged — correct per hard rule 2.

The state-gate encoding matches the prose's 'when at max stacks' clause far better than the blind's hit-count proxy; monotonic-pool divergence is documented and unreachable in-fight.

burst.kitLine: all Fire Code allies: Stack count of buffs ▲ 1
burst.driverSaid: SELF slice modeled (soda is Fire Code; her only stackable buff is Maid Spirit → +1 maidSpirit pool, clamped at 5, plus one stack application); CROSS-ALLY slice ⚑ out-of-domain engine-core — no 'bump each target's stackable buffs by N' primitive (mica-snow-buddy ⚑M5 / pepper ⚑4 precedent), with estimate + recipe + tier; refresh-semantics approximation documented
burst.blindSaid: S6 unmodeled the whole line verbatim (no primitive); S2b: GAP with a phantom-buff detector predicated on no primitive existing. The driver's self-slice goes one step further on owner precedent ('the self-slice is the honest in-scope model') and is load-bearing for the S2 gate: without it the pool would under-count the real stack state the rider reads.
burst.formulaCheck: Kit semantics = increment an existing stack count, capped at maxStacks — the driver's pool is clamped at 5 and SD6 pins count = hit procs + one per cast, discriminating against a no-self-slice counterfactual. Residual infidelity (fresh application refreshes the 10s window; applies even if no stack is currently held) is documented in the note and damage-inert for soda herself.
burst.explanation: The cross-ally amplifier is a real damage effect on Fire-stacking teams and its absence is the kit's largest honest gap — but it is documented with recipe and tier, and the engine genuinely lacks the primitive. The self-slice encoding is the best available representation and is test-pinned.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every divergence between the driver and the blind agents reconciles in the driver's favor against prose + SSOT — the S6 20s S2 interval was a self-flagged guess superseded by the datamined 12s CD the driver used; the S6 hitCount-900 rider proxy is strictly worse than the driver's resourceGate on a Maid Spirit pool (which is what S2b specified); the S6 2× nuke is the exact nearest-wrong model S2b named, with the driver's single-instance collapse carrying house precedent (anis-sparkling-summer / privaty-unkind-maid) and an explicit note. Convergence is real, not just same-model agreement: the S5 blind suite runs GREEN unmodified against the shipped override (13 pass, 3 skips that are its own GAP annotations), and the driver's 20-assertion spec pins every S2b distinguisher in both directions — halved/faster cadence counterfactuals, ungated-rider, dead-gate (S1 removed), fullBurstEnter-keyed nuke, no-self-slice, plus the inert-but-live Max-HP channel check. The two documented gaps (stun; cross-ally stack-increment) are the sanctioned dispositions with recipes and precedent. One same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the burst's '2 enemy unit(s) randomly' resolution on a single boss — both blind agents and the driver split 2-vs-1 on this and it is a clean one-popup measurement (focus-record Soda's burst: one 321.28% popup vs two); the driver ships the spec'd single-instance reading, but if footage ever shows two popups, her burst damage doubles and every other line stands.
